findings.title: Flexbox makes `.small-action` button lose right alignment
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container via `@include flexbox()`, so `float: right` on its direct child `button` is ignored. The button will be laid out immediately after `.small-action-desc` instead of being pushed to the right edge of the small-action row. Add `margin-left: auto` to the button, use `justify-content: space-between`, or otherwise reorder the flex items to preserve the previous placement.

findings.title: `align-items` mixin omits `-moz-box-align` for the `-moz-box` fallback
findings.body: The new `flexbox()` mixin emits `display: -moz-box`, but `align-items()` does not emit `-moz-box-align`. In Firefox versions that honor the `-moz-box` fallback, the cross-axis alignment will remain the initial `box-align` value (`stretch`) rather than `center` or `baseline`, so header and badge layout will be wrong on that fallback path. Add `-moz-box-align: $alignment;` to the mixin or remove the `-moz-box` display fallback.
